sampling: per-cell-type reservoir sampling (Algorithm R) over the full contiguous-block stream of every liver cell in the Census; quota = clip(round(80 + 0.004*n_cells_of_type), 40, 600)
normalization: CP10K-log1p of a single cell = log1p(count / raw_sum * 1e4), computed per cell from its own raw counts and its own raw_sum
counts_encoding: sparse [gene_index, raw_count] pairs; genes absent from the list have raw count 0 in that cell
cp10k_encoding: sparse [gene_index, value] pairs of log1p(count / raw_sum * 1e4) computed per cell from that cell's own counts and its own raw_sum; identical positions to counts
provenance: CELLxGENE Census 2025-11-08, value_filter tissue_general == 'liver' and is_primary_data == True
per_cell_claim: every row is ONE cell that was actually sequenced; the gene values are that cell's own measurements, never a cell-type mean
shard_contents: remainder of the seeded sample (all cell types, all disease states), lazily loaded
